validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" initial="p">
  <parallel id="p" final>
    <state id="r1"><transition event="done" target="end"/></state>
    <state id="r2"/>
  </parallel>
  <final id="end"/>
</scxml>

primary.message: an XML attribute needs `=` and a quoted value

notes: SCXML documents must be well-formed XML 1.0 with namespaces; no later validation runs until parsing succeeds
diagnostics.help: SCXML has no `final` attribute: a final state is the element `<final id="…"/>`; remove `final`, and write the state as `<final>` if it is meant to end its parent
